## Release (2026-10-23)

* carbon-components-ember 4.0.0 (major)
* carbon-components-ember-mcp 0.1.0 (minor)

#### :boom: Breaking Change
* `carbon-components-ember`
  * [#1182](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1182) feat!: call Search's `@onChange` with each input event, as Carbon React does ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1181](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1181) feat!: call the inputs' `@onChange` with the event, as Carbon React does ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1189](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1189) feat!: give CodeSnippet Carbon React's API and markup ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1186](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1186) feat!: render icons at 16px by default, and import their artwork with them ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1184](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1184) fix!: export the Terminal_3270 icon under its name, not Terminal_7032 ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1183](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1183) feat!: remove ConfirmDialog and the carbon.dialog-manager service ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1175](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1175) feat!: put attributes where Carbon React spreads its rest props on the rest of the components ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1174](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1174) feat!: put the inputs' attributes on the `<input>`, and take React's className as @className ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1168](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1168) feat!: take clicks as {{on "click"}} on CopyButton, OverflowMenuItem, Tile and FileUploaderDropContainer ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1153](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1153) feat!: give OverflowMenu Carbon React's API, on our floating engine ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1159](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1159) feat!: give Button Carbon React's API ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1156](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1156) feat!: render icons bare, like @carbon/icons-react ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1144](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1144) feat!: make Modal a native `<dialog>` with Carbon React's API ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1143](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1143) feat!: give Breadcrumb Carbon React's BreadcrumbItem ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1138](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1138) feat!: make Select a native `<select>`, as in Carbon React ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1142](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1142) fix(time-picker-select)!: select its value on the first render ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1096](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1096) feat!: split Notification into Carbon React's notification components ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1017](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1017) refactor: colocate component styles and ship one compiled styles.css ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#1011](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/1011) fix: apply component styles CSP-safely, and test under a strict CSP ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#991](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/991) refactor: give the charts their own barrel, with charts-react's names ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#990](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/990) refactor: stop re-exporting components into the app tree ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#988](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/988) refactor: name each component's file after its export, with a barrel for AI Chat ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#987](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/987) refactor: give FlexGrid its own module and Grid's parts React's names ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#974](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/974) feat: add InlineLoading, and match Loading to Carbon React's ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#954](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/954) feat: add AILabel and a decorator block on its hosts ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#949](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/949) Clean up component signatures and forward ...attributes on every component ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
  * [#932](https://github.com/IBM/carbon-components-ember/pull/932) refactor: use Ember 7's built-in helpers instead of addon helpers ([@aklkv](https://github.com/aklkv))
